name: Tailem Bend Info Station and Rail Museum
reason: SATC attraction list and themurrayriver listing: 1913 railway station with signal box, rail museum and history room, volunteer run (hours vary). Small museum a guide names.

name: Rotor-Sport (Murray Bridge)
reason: Operator: a gyroplane flying experience, one line in Wikivoyage Do; a business, not a place.

name: PS Marion
reason: SATC attraction; 1897 paddle steamer at Mannum Dock Museum of River History (Lonely Planet names the museum), decks and engine room can be visited. Overlaps the Dock Museum: merge if that is kept as a spot.

name: Proud Mary
reason: Operator: paddlesteamer cruises; a vehicle/tour, not a place.

name: Four Knots Murray River Cruises
reason: Operator: river cruises; a tour, not a place.

name: M.V. Dragonfly Charters and Tours
reason: Operator: charter cruises; a tour, not a place.

name: Mary Ann Reserve
reason: SATC attraction and Traveller guide: Mannum reserve with the PS Mary Ann boiler replica and pumping engine, an Engineers Australia national heritage marker for the first Murray paddle steamer. Short stop.

name: Swan Reach Observatory
reason: SATC attraction (Observatories): permanent observatory with a 70 cm telescope and public guided sessions in the Dark Sky Reserve (booking, from $85). Case against: ticketed night sessions only.

name: Swan Reach and District Museum
reason: SATC attraction listing and themurrayriver: local history museum in the 1917 school building (opened 2001). Small museum a guide names; hours not confirmed.

name: Swan Reach Conservation Park
reason: Case for: parks.sa.gov.au and SATC name it; it holds the Dark Sky Reserve core, camping and the wildlife. Case against: trails unmarked, core site 4WD only, no named walk or lookout.

name: River Murray International Dark Sky Reserve
reason: Three SATC pages and parks.sa.gov.au name it: 3,200 sq km Dark Sky Reserve with stargazing sites (Milky Way visible), guided tours. Place to go whenever it is dark.

name: Big Bend by Night
reason: Operator: a nocturnal spotlighting tour; the place it visits is Big Bend (Walker Flat).

name: Big Bend (Walker Flat)
reason: Mid Murray Council tourism ('Visit the majestic Big Bend cliffs') and themurrayriver: tallest cliffs on the Murray at the river's longest bend, lookout near Nildottie, free ferry at Walker Flat.

name: Cottage Box Chocolates
reason: A chocolate maker/cafe: a shop, not an attraction.

name: Marula Day Spa
reason: A day spa: a business.

name: Juggle House Experiences
reason: An experiences operator: a business, not a place.

name: Kinchina Conservation Park
reason: parks.sa.gov.au: granite outcrops, Jailhouse Rocks Loop (1.8 km), Lavender Federation Trail, parking bay off Maurice Road; also listed by SATC.

name: Mount Boothby Conservation Park
reason: SATC and themurrayriver: named for a 129 m granite/limestone outcrop, spring orchids, Boothby Rocks Reserve picnic area. Case against: 4WD tracks, little infrastructure. Tolmer Rocks is the same SATC listing.

name: Tolmer Rocks
reason: Duplicate of Mount Boothby Conservation Park: SATC and themurrayriver list them as one 'Tolmer Rocks - Mount Boothby Conservation Park' attraction.

name: Shell Hill Reserve
reason: SATC and themurrayriver: 5-million-year-old oyster-shell deposit, listed Dark Sky viewing site. Small stop, geology a guide names.

name: Marne Valley Conservation Park
reason: themurrayriver and parks.sa.gov.au: 105 ha red-gum flats, management tracks only, 'no specific trail information'; no named walk, lookout or feature (searched both).

name: Messent Conservation Park
reason: themurrayriver: 4WD-only sandy tracks, malleefowl habitat; no named walk, lookout or feature; parks.sa.gov.au page 404.

name: Ridley Conservation Park
reason: themurrayriver and parks.sa.gov.au: flat mallee park, 'no specific trail information'; only an unnamed high point (Hayward's Hill) and a disused quarry.

name: Tauragat Hill
reason: SATC and themurrayriver: gentle bush-trail climb to a survey marker with views over Coonalpyn and farmland. Short visit; second-tier lookout.

name: Dickson Reserve
reason: Case for: themurrayriver and SATC; State-heritage 1924 ferry landing remains, start of the Lower Murray Canoe Trail, riverside at Tailem Bend. Case against: mostly a riverside picnic reserve and houseboat mooring.

name: Lenger Reserve
reason: SATC and themurrayriver: 95 ha National Trust bird sanctuary near Mannum with 208 native plant species and a c.1900 pug-and-pine cottage. Case against: remote, little infrastructure.

name: Karte Conservation Park
reason: parks.sa.gov.au: 1.5 km (45 min) Karte hike from the campground with interpretive signs and district views, malleefowl habitat; open daily.

name: Ngarkat Conservation Park
reason: parks.sa.gov.au: large mallee wilderness, 4WD only, 11 campgrounds and 10 walks (Box Flat ruins, Gosse Hill hike); also SATC.

name: Mount Monster Conservation Park
reason: parks.sa.gov.au: unusual granite outcrop, 600 m summit hike (30 min) and 1.2 km Gwen Ellis Walking Trail, picnics, wildflowers.

name: Mount Monster summit hike
reason: Duplicate of Mount Monster Conservation Park: a 30-minute walk inside the park, not a separate spot.

name: Lake St Clair Conservation Park
reason: parks.sa.gov.au: swamp bird habitat, 'no bushwalking information', no camping, no named feature or walk; searched park page only.

name: Cambrai Agricultural Museum
reason: SATC lists it only as 'Cambrai Agricultural Museum Open Day': open on event days, not there whenever a visitor arrives (rule 4).

name: The Eric Parker Collection
reason: Private motoring museum at Truro, reported closed to the public for renovations; no confirmed reopening.

name: Pioneer Park (Karoonda)
reason: themurrayriver: pioneer buildings, machinery and rolling stock, 1 km nature trail, open to walk through at any time; also on SATC.

name: Mallee Playground Trail
reason: Community playgrounds in Wynarka, Karoonda and Wanbi; local play parks, not a distinct draw for travellers (Karoonda's silo art and Big Ram are the stops).

name: Lameroo Silo Art
reason: themurrayriver and SATC: two painted grain silos (Smug 2024, 2025 diptych) with a park beside them; a roadside icon.

name: Mallee Tourist and Heritage Centre
reason: themurrayriver (two pages): Pinnaroo museum with engines, farm memorabilia, working Letterpress Printing Museum and a 1000-variety grain collection.

name: Heart of the Parks (Tintinara)
reason: A craft and produce shop; a business, not an attraction.

name: Coonalpyn Downs Silo Art
reason: themurrayriver Coorong page names the Coonalpyn silo art (Guido van Helten's mural on the Dukes Highway); a roadside icon travellers stop for.

name: Lake Roberts (Lameroo)
reason: Council and themurrayriver: a picnic ground with BBQ shelter and caravan park on the edge of Lameroo; ordinary local park, no distinct draw.

name: Hunter Road Lookout
reason: Two SATC Riverland pages: free clifftop lookout over the Murray, Blanchetown and Paisley Wetlands, 2.3 km off the Sturt Highway at Paisley. In sa-murray-coorong (Riverland and Blanchetown).

name: Holder Bend Lookout
reason: Two SATC Riverland pages: free clifftop lookout at a Murray bend near Waikerie, wide views, popular with photographers.
